Class Logger

java.lang.Object
Utils.Logger
public class Logger extends Object
Utils.Utils.Logger is a flexible, thread-safe logging utility with support for console and file logging, log rotation, and runtime configuration.

Features: - Log levels: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, OFF - Console and file output - File appending or rolling log file with timestamp - Automatic log rotation based on file size (default 1MB) - Thread safety for file operations - ANSI color-coded console output

    • Logger

      public Logger(String loggerName)
      Constructs a new Utils.Utils.Logger instance with the given name. The logger will write to console and to a file (log.txt if appending, or timestamped file if not).
      Parameters:
      loggerName - a string identifying the logger (shown in output)
